liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (3 reviews): Bird Song closed spellbindingly, leading the listener to predict a Dark Star in the second set; Reviewer calls the Bird Song out of this world [12][14][20]
- **Shakedown Street** (2 reviews): Shakedown was long and funky; Jerry's solo in Shakedown is exceptionally good; reviewer recommends playing it loud [12][19]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Jerry sings only the first verse, but the band emerges from the depths to play the second verse's melody; Dark Star is jazzy and spacy, while The Other One rocks [12][19]
- First set was played well, especially The Same Thing [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **long talk and tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-03-20.fob.schoeps.gems.76478.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 161 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Pops, glitches and crowd noises were hand-edited; some zips remain, especially in Brown Eyed Women [1]
- **gd1992-03-20.mtx.seamons.95208.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 161 min; rated 4.5/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Missing Brown Eyed Women and the opening notes of Bucket; glitches in Mexicali, Promised Land and U.S. Blues [2]
- **gd1992-03-20.155835.FOBSchoepsMasterDAT.BrotmanMetchickAnonNoel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 17 songs; 163 min [4]
- **gd1992-03-20.sonicstudios.schmit.mallick.116465.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 167 min [5]. Said about its sound: Occasional level fluctuations in the second set [5]
- **gd92-03-20.sbd.gardner.9757.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 144 min; rated 4/5 by 36 [6]. Said about its sound: Phil's bass sounds extraordinarily alive on this soundboard; U.S. Blues is very loud, with a glitch [17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's car broke down at the border near Buffalo en route from New Paltz; a Canadian couple sold a face-value ticket [13]
- Audience noise after Women Are Smarter, as Jerry starts Dark Star's first notes, is striking on the audience tape [14]
- Reviewer lived twenty minutes away; says these were the last Canadian shows, and Toronto's Sky Dome was planned for fall 1995 [16]
- Reviewer took his brother to his first show and also has the shows on video [16]
- Reviewer says Vince Welnick played, not Bruce Hornsby; mounted police with big yellow happy faces were outside [21]
- Reviewer insists Bruce Hornsby played both nights, citing photos, a VHS and the tapes [22]
- Todd lent his gear to a friend, who taped; set one was handheld, set two planned on a stand [2]
- Mics were hidden or muffled during Bird Song to avoid detection, hence the patch [4]
- Reviewer thought it hard to top the band's 1990 effort at this venue, but loved both shows [20]
- Reviewer suggests 3/20 plus 3/21 first-set filler would make an excellent Dick's Picks release [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-03-20.fob.schoeps.gems.76478.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by GEMS; source: Schoeps CMC34 Cardiod (110 degrees ORTF) -> Oade Supply -> Panasonic 2v255 [1]. Also: Schoeps front-of-board audience recording, with Bird Song patched from shnid 9757; a 48kHz tracked version exists [1]
- **gd1992-03-20.mtx.seamons.95208.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [2]. Also: Digital audience recording from 13th row center, Schoeps CMC34 in ORTF, through Oade Supply to Panasonic; at least one cassette generation [2]
- **gd1992-03-20.155835.FOBSchoepsMasterDAT.BrotmanMetchickAnonNoel.t-flac1648**: taped by Recording by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick; transferred by Transfer by Anonymous Edited & Mastered (Adobe Audition) by Joe Noel January 12, 2022; source: Recording: FOB Schoeps CMC34 (ORTF) > Tao Research > M1000 cables > Panasonic SV-255mod (16/48) > Master DAT [4]
- **gd1992-03-20.sonicstudios.schmit.mallick.116465.flac16**: taped by Alan Schmit; transferred by Dave Mallick; source: Master: Sonic Studios DSM-6>Sony TCD-D5M by Alan Schmit, 15th row center; Conversion: Cass(m)>Onkyo TA-6711>Tascam DA-20 (A/D)>Microtrack 24/96>WAV WAV>Sound… [5]
- **gd92-03-20.sbd.gardner.9757.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>CDR [6]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Fred Strame Grateful Dead: [1992-03-20 Copps Coliseum, Hamilton, Ontario, Canada - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-03-20-copps-coliseum-hamilton-ontario-canada/) [24]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 3/20/92 Copps Coliseum, Hamilton, ON, Can…](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27295845461/) [25]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27295845461/) [26]
